q: A hydrogen peroxide contact lens disinfecting system must be neutralized before wear because un-neutralized peroxide is:
o: too weak to store the lens
w: Hydrogen peroxide disinfects well but stings and burns the eye until neutralized to saline. A non-neutralized lens causes an immediate chemical keratitis.
k: Peroxide must be neutralized; otherwise it is toxic to the eye.

q: Which older contact lens solution preservative contains mercury and is now avoided due to hypersensitivity?
w: Thimerosal is a mercury-containing preservative linked to hypersensitivity and has been largely replaced. Benzalkonium chloride is another older preservative, weak against Pseudomonas.
